summary: Iteration-3: 39/39 backend pytest cases pass (20 family-finance regression + 11 iteration-2 regression + 8 new iteration-3). New iteration-3 cases verify (a) dashboard new shape — current_balance/saved/breakdown{income,expense,emi_by_loan,sip_by_investment} present and monthly_cash_flow removed, (b) active-only totals (closed investments/loans excluded from total_invested/portfolio_value/loan_outstanding), (c) range-scoping by start_date overlap (old out-of-range active inv/loan excluded from total_invested/loan_outstanding while net_worth/portfolio_value stay all-time), (d) POST /api/loans/{id}/mark_paid_till_now creates N backdated EMI payments (12 expected for 12-mo-old loan w/ EMI=10000 → ~120000, allows 11-13 for boundary), is idempotent (second call adds 0), and is no-op for future-dated loans, (e) breakdown emi_by_loan/sip_by_investment populated when /api/reminders/pay creates EMI/SIP txs with source linkage. Also updated test_family_finance.py TestDashboard to use the new field set (kept regression coverage). Frontend smoke (mobile viewport, demo@family.app/demo1234): dashboard renders greeting, reminder-badge (count=1), net-worth-card, allocation-pie, range pills (All time / 1 yr / 3 mo / This month / Custom — Custom opens modal with From/To month pickers and Apply button works). More → Reports screen opens; range pills (This month/3 mo/1 yr/All time) and Expense/Income toggle render and toggle works. Recurring '/ month' subtitle, 'All EMIs paid till this month' checkbox, and 'Delete permanently' buttons (investment-detail/loan-detail/transaction-form) all confirmed via code review with proper testIDs. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch all absent). No critical issues.

minor.issue: Inconsistent timezone usage: server.py uses datetime.now() (server-local) inside mptn, but iso(now_utc())[:10] for tx dates elsewhere. May off-by-one near midnight UTC. Not blocking.

issues: Modal shows From=Apr 2026 / To=Jun 2026 by default which is in the future for 2025-based mock data. Consider defaulting From to (today − 2 months) and To to today for sane initial range.

action_items: (Optional) Align mark_paid_till_now timezone with now_utc() to avoid month-boundary skew (datetime.now() vs iso(now_utc()))
(Optional) Custom range modal initial From/To should default to (now-2mo, now) instead of (Apr 2026, Jun 2026)

(Optional) Add testIDs on the range pills using stable keys (range-all is OK; verify range-1y/range-3m/range-thismonth render — selector tests found only range-all on first attempt; visually all five pills render correctly so likely a quick re-query timing artifact, but worth confirming testID strings exactly match the `key` field on each pill)
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard correctly separates range-scoped totals (total_invested, loan_outstanding, active_investments, active_loans) from all-time active totals (portfolio_value, net_worth) per spec.
_in_range helper uses string-compare which is safe for ISO yyyy-mm-dd dates.
mark_paid_till_now correctly skips already-paid months via $addToSet + already-set check; payments and paid_months stay in sync.
Dashboard breakdown groups EMI/SIP by source_id and resolves names via 1 round-trip — clean.
Reminder pay endpoint records BOTH loan.payments (for remaining_balance) and transactions (for EMI category breakdown) — correct dual-write pattern.
transaction-form delete button only mounts in edit mode (testID delete-tx-btn) — correct.
